text: 10 Nov morning: Isaac sessions 4-5 done (US$30.50 total estimated, cleanup verified each time). Composed homes: an asset-embedded PhysicsScene made the G1 fall; deactivating it lets all four dev homes stand, cross rooms and capture (467 dev frames at 320x240 and 640x480). Detector comparison on 241 dev frames: Qwen3-VL precise but low recall, OWLv2 high recall with very low precision; 640x480 raises recall. Selection rule pre-declared (precision@IoU0.3 >= 0.70 operating point, then max recall@0.3) before the home-frame results; session 6 runs the detectors on the home frames. Diagnosis (dev only): knowledge changes 7-12% of decisions, its shift (1.4-3.6 m2) is small against information gain (10-17 m2), the typical room is labelled before the target is seen in under half the homes; the unexplored-room mechanism did not help on dev, so K2 as drafted is not frozen. Next: oracle-room upper bound and kappa calibration on dev xl, then a frozen K2.
